title: Lateral Reading & Source Credibility
goal: Practice the single most important habit found missing in the Stanford History Education Group's national study of student online reasoning: actually leaving the page to check who's behind it, on a real organization, before trusting what it says — not just reasoning about it in the abstract.
time: 40 min · **Materials:** a phone, tablet, or computer with internet access — this is required by default this session (see Section 5); the no-device version is a fallback only, in the tutor notes.
